title: Ticket Fares — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The fare for one route, passenger type and ticket class, from a given date.

Tickets valued by FareAmount take the fare for the employee's route, the ticket class of their grade and the passenger type of the traveller's age. The monthly ticket provision values accrued tickets at the return fare.

fields.label: TicketRouteId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Ticket Route master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The route.

Example. Kuwait – Cairo

fields.label: TicketPaxTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Ticket Pax Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The passenger type, by age.

Example. Adult

fields.label: TicketClassId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Ticket Class master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The ticket class.

Example. Economy

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Saving closes the previous record for the same ticket route and ticket pax type and ticket class on the day before this date; the latest record stays open.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: OneWayTicketFare
fields.html:
What it is. The one-way fare.

Example. 95

Why it matters. Used when the grade's ticket rule is set to one way. It cannot be negative.

fields.label: ReturnTicketFare
fields.html:
What it is. The return fare.

Example. 170

Why it matters. Used when the grade's ticket rule is set to return, and for the monthly ticket provision. It cannot be negative.
